releases.title: GrimKeep
releases.summary: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

releases.title: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
releases.summary: Winx Club: The Magic is Back is an adventure game set in the Winx universe, in which players take on the role of Bloom and explore the Magic Dimension in an original story. Players can transform and fly freely through an open world featuring familiar locations such as Alfea, Cloud Tower, Red Fountain, and Magix City, while solving puzzles, battling enemies, and uncovering secrets. The story revolves around the Festival of the 100 Moons, which is disrupted by a mysterious threat. Beyond the main adventure, the game features 32 challenges across four game modes and offers up to 24 playable characters from the franchise.

releases.title: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
releases.summary: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

releases.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World - Digital Deluxe Edition
Luma Island
releases.summary: Luma Island is a casual life simulation and farming game where players explore a peaceful island, grow crops, care for animals, and interact with a small community of characters. The game focuses on day-to-day activities, resource gathering, and simple crafting mechanics in a relaxed, open-ended environment.

releases.title: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
releases.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. The villainess Scarlet, deceived and falsely accused of killing of the King, becomes the first streamer. Through this, she uses manipulates and diversion to rebel against the vast military force of the Imperial Kingdom.

releases.title: Mombo Combo Legacy
releases.summary: Mombo Combo Legacy is a fast-paced platformer packed with action and adventure! Battle monstrous enemies, unlock powerful forms, and pull off incredible combos across hundreds of handcrafted levels. Customize your Mombo with stylish skins, collect and evolve Orumon pets, and take down epic bosses in your quest to save the universe. Easy to play, hard to master — and all powered by skill, courage… and a whole lot of tongue.

releases.title: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster
releases.summary:
Explore haunting landscapes, engage in epic dogfights, and uncover ancient secrets in a visually enhanced, rebalanced edition of the BAFTA-nominated, award-winning original.

The Remaster includes:
• Improved flight controls, animations and collisions.
• Balances and changes to escort missions and those idle downtimes.
• A filled up world.
• Edge of the World expansion content now included in the base game.
• Additional new content, voice overs and much more.

releases.title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.4 - The Finality of the Day
releases.summary: The story of the Sky Island of Roscaelifer reaches its final climax, as Sunbringer, a new Void Hunter and the first Enchainer Agent, joins the fight. The new version also kicks off the Zenless Zone Zero × Honkai: Star Rail collaboration, introducing two crossover Agents, Robin and Kafka, along with themed events. It also brings new combat gameplay, updates to permanent game modes, and a variety of version rewards.

releases.title: Rayman Legends Retold
releases.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

releases.title: Edge of Memories
releases.summary: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

releases.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
releases.summary: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

releases.title: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
releases.summary:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

Enjoy Rayman Origins like never before with 4K resolution, 60 FPS, and modern enhancements, including new quality-of-life features. Discover 60 hidden Relics across the adventure and track your progress in the Snoring Tree.

releases.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
releases.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the Dragon Quest series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

releases.title: Waltz and Jam
releases.summary: Waltz is a pure and innocent soul who awoke in Downtown, and Jam is the lovable dog who was there waiting. Join them on this amazing and heartwarming journey.

releases.title: Aeterna Lucis
releases.summary: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

releases.title: Cronos: Lazarus
releases.summary: Wield the Warden’s power in this combat‑heavy expansion to Cronos: The New Dawn, pushing the series toward faster, more aggressive action. Teleport, strike, and outrun a relentless hunter using enhanced traversal, decoys, and temporary invisibility as you race to revive a lost Essence before the Collective closes in.

releases.title: Sombras: Negative Frames
releases.summary: ‘Sombras: Negative Frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

releases.title: CitaDrill
releases.summary: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

releases.title: Freestyle Football 2
releases.summary: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

releases.title: Thysiastery
releases.summary: Thysiastery is a dungeon crawler RPG featuring traditional roguelike and turn-based gameplay. Command a party of bearers of the Brand, drawn into a vast Labyrinth. Recruit while exploring the Labyrinth in hope of finding a way out, and its secrets will be revealed as you delve deeper.

releases.title: Fall Up
releases.summary: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

releases.title: The Dark Queen of Mortholme
releases.summary:
You are the Dark Queen—the most powerful being of your entire universe. Your lair is breached by an aspiring hero—a pitiful thing, easily crushed.

Except they keep coming back.

A 20 minute anti-game about an unconventional relationship and the capacity for change.

releases.title: PowerWash Simulator 2: Barbie Pack
releases.summary: With Barbie, You Can Be Anything! Turns out, “anything” includes a PowerWasher Barbie. Step outside of the box and power wash your way through Malibu in this clean-up adventure spanning five levels. Spray away muck, revealing sparkling, pristine plastic beneath!

releases.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered - Digital Deluxe Edition
releases.summary: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

releases.title: Zero Hour
releases.summary: Zero Hour is a tactical FPS with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted in Bangladesh with Real-life scale & resource management. It brings a grounded, close quarter combat experience to the game.

releases.title: Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith
releases.summary: Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith is a crafting simulation game where you Physically interact with your tools. Manage the complete process, resource acquisition, mining ore, gather resource to crafting weapons and armors for your customers. Craft items, forge and increase your blacksmith skills!

releases.title: Survival Machine
releases.summary: Build your base on a machine in a constant motion, travel through biomes with different resources, and prepare for the night when a zombie threat is much higher than during a day. Would you go solo or explore this new world with your best friends?

releases.title: A Game About Digging A Hole Together
releases.summary: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.

releases.title: Tuesday Morning.
releases.summary: Tuesday Morning is a single-player, ritualistic action title focused on combat and minimalism. Set in a single arena, experiment with its mechanics, discover what works in combat for yourself, and develop the skills to put your ideas into practice.

releases.title: LarsGadiel
releases.summary: LarsGadiel is a classic NES-style Metroidvania and the prequel to Xenon Valkyrie.

releases.title: Bleeding Nightmare
releases.summary: Descend into the fever dreams of a traumatized young man in a first-person psychological horror game about grief, trauma, and fractured memories. Confront the horrors of your past and find a way back home from Hell.

releases.title: Attack on Titan 3
releases.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

releases.title: Attack on Titan 3: Digital Deluxe Edition
releases.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

releases.title: Guns of Eschaton
releases.summary: The worlds first soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-opgo West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

releases.title: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
releases.summary: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a single-player survival game played from a third-person view and set in an open world. Players control a member of a hominid clan and manage its needs by eating, drinking, and sleeping while facing predators and other dangers in the wild. Exploring new places and being hunted can trigger a state of fear, which is offset by rewarding actions such as crafting tools and making discoveries. As the clan learns and grows, players unlock new skills through a neural development system and can switch between clan members, passing acquired abilities to future generations. The game has no structured narrative campaign and instead lets players shape their own experience.

releases.title: Don't Fret
releases.summary: Don't! Fret is stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights.

releases.title: Teardown: Rally
releases.summary:
A brand-new game mode and we can't wait to get you behind the wheel! Compete in quick races, tournaments and cups with a fresh lineup of speedy Rally Cars and mighty Monster Trucks, each with its own distinct handling. Find your favourite, floor it and try to remember where the brakes are.

Picture 12 players drifting across Frozen Lake, launching off massive jumps in the Quarry and making a spectacular mess of the landing. That's the kind of racing we're here for.

And who says you have to stay in the car? Hop out, wreck your opponents' vehicles and help your team take the win. Overtaking is much easier when the other car isn't going anywhere.

releases.title: Raider Kid and the Ruby Chest
releases.summary: Sneak away from your boring family vacation and delve into ANCIENT RUINS! Borrow equipment from dead explorers and uncover the secrets of a lost civilization as you leave your parents worried sick. WARNING: The Ruby Chest may contain traces of an ancient curse (and gluten).

releases.title: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor - Henry Add-On
Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Processional of the Damned
releases.summary: Venture into the Processional — a massive, otherworldly graveyard of ships lost to the void. What begins as a search for riches turns into a descent into the unknown. Navigate shifting corridors, avoid ancient traps, and uncover strange truths that defy logic. A new companion joins your crew — someone shaped by this impossible place. This expansion introduces new story, a mysterious new region, unique enemies and some fresh gameplay mechanics.

releases.title: Marathon: Symbiosis
releases.summary: The Symbiosis update introduces the PvE Expedition mode, the PvP Deathmatch Beta, new weapons, the Bishop Runner shell and expanded areas to explore on Tau Ceti IV.

releases.title: Elements Destiny
releases.summary: Use the power of the elements and face your destiny. Elements Destiny is a 2D Fantasy RPG with pixelated retro visuals. An emotional story with a deep story, challenging turn based combat and handcrafted artworks. And yes, the soundtrack is massive!

releases.title: Pizza Slice
releases.summary: More than just a simulator, Pizza Slice is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area!

releases.title: Wish Upon a Llama
releases.summary: Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!

releases.title: Yamigatari: For3st
releases.summary: Alone in a forest that won’t let her go, Nora is being followed by an unseen entity that draws closer with every step. A 2D psychological horror with seven endings shaped by your choices.

releases.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
releases.summary: Set in America after the end of the Wild West era, this new adventure takes place in Steam Bison, a remarkable town of invention transformed by rapid advances in steam technology. But as something mysterious is taking place there, Professor Layton and Luke find themselves drawn into a new adventure.

releases.title: Stage Tour
releases.summary: Stage Tour is a rhythm-action game that blends familiar, accessible note-highway gameplay with exciting modern twists. It’s poised to rekindle the flame of plastic-instrument rhythm gaming with new features and modes, diverse bandmates and instruments, competitive depth, and seasonal events.

releases.title: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
releases.summary:
Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded is an arcade-style beat ’em up that combines baseball and martial arts, this action game has players battling through side-scrolling stages with pitches, swings, grabs, throws, combos, and special attacks. Up to four players can team up in shared-screen co-op to reclaim a stolen trophy.

Expanding on the original arcade release, the game adds a playable character, new stages, an arranged mode with revised enemy layouts, minigames, and newly arranged music alongside the original soundtrack.

releases.title: Aeruta
releases.summary:
A bread revolution across the world now begins!
Aeruta is a side-scrolling action game with a shop management twist, fight monsters for materials and use them to make breads, then finally make the deserted town popular again!

releases.title: Shikhondo: Blue Pieta
releases.summary: Once more, the hunt for Youkai begins! Across the ocean in a city far, far away, the side-scrolling shoot 'em up action of our two protagonists unfolds! Complete the Pietà of struggle that burns blue with its raging barrage!

releases.title: Agent Skunk: Stink Ops
releases.summary:
Step into the paws of the world’s stealthiest operative! Play as a highly trained skunk agent on a mission to save the multiverse from an evil zebra commander. Sneak into enemy territory, sabotage operations, and neutralize threats. Cute on the outside, highly effective on the job.

In this stealth-action adventure, every mission is an opportunity to outsmart your enemies. Slip through bushes, disappear into clouds of smoke, and catch opponents off guard with stealthy takedowns. Need to handle a group of enemies? Unleash your skunk’s signature stink attack to neutralize everyone within its range. Stealth is your greatest weapon, but you can always stand your ground when things get messy!

releases.title: Winter Resort Simulator 3
releases.summary: Run your own ski resort in Winter Resort Simulator 3. Operate ropeways, groom slopes and manage snow. Explore the biggest world in the series alone or with friends. Whether you're operating lifts, grooming slopes, or preparing for the next busy season, WRS 3 puts you in charge of the mountain.

releases.title: Path of Exile 2
releases.summary: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG created by Grinding Gear Games. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading. Path of Exile 2 is a free-to-play online multiplayer game with co-op for up to six players.

releases.title: I Am Jesus Christ
releases.summary: Walk in the footsteps of Jesus in this immersive first-person retelling of His life, from baptism to resurrection. Perform iconic miracles, meet biblical figures, and explore the Holy Land from Jerusalem to Galilee. Experience the story of the Messiah in I Am Jesus Christ.

releases.title: Gloosh!
releases.summary: Run, jump and dash through a momentum-driven 3D platformer with incremental progression. Record runs, let clones earn income, buy upgrades and return faster. Refine your routes, collect stars and chase better course times in Gloosh!

releases.title: Silver Palace
releases.summary: Silver Palace is an upcoming open‑world detective action‑adventure RPG developed by Silver Studio and published by Elementa worldwide. It is set in the sprawling Victorian‑style metropolis of Sylvanea, built upon the revolutionary element known as Silver Liquid that has fueled its industrial and social transformation. Players assume the role of a detective tasked with unraveling complex criminal conspiracies and uncovering hidden truths scattered throughout the city. The game seamlessly blends open‑world exploration with dynamic real‑time combat, featuring character switching, skill combos, and QTE‑style finishers. Traversal options include horseback riding, aerial wire‑grappling, and free‑running across richly detailed environments. Silver Palace is built on Unreal Engine 5, delivering high‑fidelity anime‑inspired visuals and cinematic battle sequences. It will be available on PC, major consoles, iOS, and Android devices with pre‑registration now open for global audiences. The title adopts a free‑to‑play model enhanced by gacha mechanics for character and gear progression. An 11‑minute gameplay showcase has been released, offering a deep dive into the game’s mechanics and world‑building. No firm release date has been announced, but further details and developer updates will be shared via the official website and social channels.

releases.title: Dome Keeper
releases.summary:
Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action mining game. Use the time between attacks to dig beneath the surface in search of valuable resources and relics – deliver them back to your dome to unlock powerful upgrades and useful new gadgets.
But it won’t be long until the relentless monsters return - do you risk delving deeper into the mine? Or return to base and prepare for imminent attack? The choice is yours, but make it quickly!

releases.title: Stardust: Wish of Witch
releases.summary: STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

releases.title: Frostpunk 2: The Surge
releases.summary: Experience a highly story-driven campaign set in a brand-new region far beyond previous borders.

releases.title: You're Nuts!
releases.summary: Escape from a decaying industrial maze where logic is the only way out. Scout for shortcuts, scavenge parts to craft upgrades and make sure to come back to your safety hub each day to protect your cover. A cozy co-op adventure for 1-4 sentient robots. Can you find the key and reach the exit in time?

releases.title: Haul Yeah!
releases.summary: Load it, strap it, drive it. A colourful delivery-driving sandbox for one or two players. Stack real physics cargo, tighten the straps and haul it across a mountain county in split-screen co-op or solo. Build your business with better trucks, custom parts and bigger jobs.

releases.title: Dancin' Divas
releases.summary: A robbery has taken place! Four Diva's from around the world are showcasing their treasures at the local lounge but things have gone south. It's time to fight back!

releases.title: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
releases.summary: Dominate the lanes in PBA Pro Bowling 2027! Customize your bowler’s unique style and arsenal with in-depth ball mechanics and Perks. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode and Online Leagues, and defend your title in Online Tournaments and Ranked Play. This is where champions are made.

releases.title: Sunsoft is Back! Retro Game Selection 2
releases.summary: The "bad game" classic is back! Mysteries to unravel! The second installment in the “Retro Game Selection” series is here. Includes four classic titles ranging from major Sunsoft hits to hidden gems. New save and rewind features! Find rare never-before-seen game materials in Gallery Mode!

releases.title: Aooni: The Horror of Blueberry Onsen
releases.summary: Challenge yourself while being chased by fear! A horror puzzle action adventure! A completely new version of the legendary horror game "Ao Oni"!

releases.title: Aooni2
releases.summary:
The latest installment in the legendary horror franchise, Aooni!

Uncover the mystery while fleeing for your life! A pulse-pounding puzzle-horror action-adventure!

This time, the stage is set in a school, featuring two massive, star-studded scenarios!

releases.title: Nioh 3: Bloody Insurrection
releases.summary: The second Nioh 3 DLC

releases.title: Heavy Duty
releases.summary: Heavy Duty isn’t just about driving. It’s about controlling the toughest machines on Earth and leading a crew through high-stakes missions. Pick your cargo carefully, balance every load, and be ready to drop, crack, break, and try again until the job gets done.

releases.title: Fate Trigger
releases.summary: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, craft your own strategies, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

releases.title: Mudang: Two Hearts
releases.summary: MUDANG: Two Hearts is a narrative-driven, third-person action adventure that blends tactical stealth, visceral combat, and cinematic storytelling set on a politically volatile Korean peninsula.

releases.title: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
releases.summary: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

releases.title: Thick as Thieves
releases.summary:
Enter the shadows in this introduction to Thick as Thieves. In the shadow-draped streets of Kilcairn, fortune favours the bold. As a member of the Thieves' Guild, you'll undertake daring heists to claim precious heirlooms and uncover arcane secrets hidden within this alternate-history 1910s Scottish city, where magic and early technology have begun to collide.

Whether working alone or playing online co-op, only the most cunning will seize their fortune in Thick as Thieves!

releases.title: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions
releases.summary: STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe with a focus on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, players will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete planet- wide objectives across a multitude of star systems using cutting edge technology.

releases.title: Dark Mass
releases.summary: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

releases.title: Truckful
releases.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

releases.title: Breathedge 2
releases.summary: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

releases.title: About Fishing
releases.summary: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

releases.title: Opus: Prism Peak
releases.summary: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

releases.title: Lost Hellden
releases.summary: Lost Hellden is a unique 3D hand-painted J-RPG from Artisan Studios, enhanced by dynamic lighting and weather effects. Follow Cyphel and his allies as a mature story unfolds. Customize your characters as you see fit and dive into a battle system that mixes action and strategy.

releases.title: Toxic Crusaders
releases.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

releases.title: Bylina
releases.summary: Embark on an epic journey to the Far Far Kingdom and challenge Koschei the Deathless to save your immortal soul and become a true hero in Bylina, an Action RPG rooted in Slavic folklore and myths. Take on the role of Falconet, a young bogatyr born without hero's powers, shunned and underestimated by almost everyone. Conquer numerous ordeals, overcome insurmountable odds, and become a legendary hero whose tales will be told for ages to come.

releases.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow
releases.summary: Voyage across and beneath the salt-stricken seas in this thrilling nautically-themed expansion of Hollow Knight: Silksong, free for all players in 2026!

releases.title: Island of Winds
releases.summary:
Island of Winds takes you to 17th century Iceland, plunging them into a magical world teeming with trolls, giant spiders, and mythical creatures. Experience all of this through the eyes of the magic-wielding Brynhild, a member of the Balance Keepers who draws her magical power from the natural world.

Brynhild's journey has her on a quest to find her mentor, Hrymja, that will take her through nine incredible landscapes that draw on Iceland's stunning natural beauty. These locations range from the fiery Lava of Skjól to the treacherous Jökla lagoon and gleaming Obsidian Shore. Brynhild will face legendary creatures on her journey, such as the powerful and majestic Bear King, Hafgúfa - Guardian of the Sea and the majestic elven lady Vör of the Oasis.

releases.title: Town of Zoz
releases.summary: Fight with flavor! As Ito, a young shaman chef adventurer, you'll hunt critters, gather magical ingredients and rebuild bonds by cooking for the townspeople. A shaman chef always aims to lend a helping hand, but the more Ito gets involved, the more he'll learn about the town and its ancient secrets.

releases.title: Inazuma Eleven Re
releases.summary: The story that started Inazuma Eleven will be revived in a remake!

releases.title: Bogdan's Cross
releases.summary: Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a fallen Templar seeking to make amends for his past sins. Explore a stunning world filled with ancient mysteries, uncover hidden secrets, and battle fierce enemies in this immersive action-adventure game.

releases.title: Lost Skies
releases.summary: Chart a course in a breathtaking, but fractured world. Explore ancient ruins, master advanced technology, and craft your very own skyship to brave nature’s fury and colossal threats in Lost Skies. Team up with friends or go it alone in this awe-inspiring cooperative survival adventure.

releases.title: Slain 2: The Beast Within
releases.summary: A brutal gothic hack-and-slash where steel and savagery collide. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn, embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world. The time for hesitation is over. The quest begins now. Akran’s fate - and the fate of the kingdom - rests in your hands.

releases.title: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
releases.summary: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a Monster Collector RPG set in the wonderful land of Talea. Trey, who has mysteriously lost his memories, decides to set on a journey after a particular event. His only guiding light will be a mysterious desire... but will that be true?

releases.title: Barkour
releases.summary: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

releases.title: V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls
releases.summary: V.E.D.A is a Soulslike training game with weighty combat and exploration. The protagonist, awakened with no memory, undergoes combat training in a training simulator and uncovers hidden secrets. You too can enter the Soulslike genre. Don't hesitate.

releases.title: Spook-A-Boo
releases.summary: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost-hunting couch co-op game for up to four players. Team up with friends and family to locate and capture sneaky ghosts hiding in plain sight.

releases.title: Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North
releases.summary: A New Age Rises in Age of Empires IV. Raiders of the North introduces two full civilizations, deeper Crucible systems, and more.

releases.title: Pocket Wheels
releases.summary: Pocket Wheels isn't just a racing game, it's an objective-based 3D platformer. Take a seat in various toy cars with special abilities and explore a house full of themed rooms filled with collectibles, objectives and race tracks!

releases.title: Out and About
releases.summary: You've come to help your Granny after a terrible storm destroyed her cottage and wreaked havoc in her idyllic coastal town. Can you find a way of restoring her home and uniting the townsfolk? Connect with nature by foraging, gardening, and cooking, then try out your new skills in the real world!

releases.title: Farmbotic
releases.summary: Get ready to venture into the world of Farmatic. Prepare to automate the farm work with the help of your trusty bots. Explore and fight your way through the mines. Optimize the transportation of your resources and help the villagers with their tasks. All that alone or with friends!

releases.title: Dumb Ways to Party
releases.summary: The worlds dumbest party game is here! Play as your favorite Bean, and go head-to-head with up to three other players to become the Dumbest of the Dumb. Will you use skill, sabotage or sheer dumb luck to win?

releases.title: Where Winds Meet: The Imperial Palace
Deadzone Rogue 2
releases.summary: Fight as Talon 13-10 in this FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends.

releases.title: Sanitarium Enhanced
releases.summary: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

releases.title: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
releases.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

releases.title: Brightfall
releases.summary: Lived through the Plague, did you? Now try surviving till morning on an island erased from the maps. Gather, build, and fight to keep your light alive in Brightfall - a co-op open world survival-craft roguelite where the darkness wants to swallow you whole.

releases.title: Astromeda
releases.summary: Astromeda is an adventure RPG, featuring unique fast-paced and turn-based battles in a mysterious, charming world. You are a human who returns to an Earth inhabited by intelligent Bacteria. Explore a rich world, befriend or fight quirky characters, and uncover the mysteries of the Bacteria race. The game is inspired by Undertale, H

releases.title: Haruka: Beyond the Stars
releases.summary: Haruka: Beyond the Stars is a juvenile sci-fi RPG about the intergalactic adventures of the protagonist, Yuuki, and a mysterious girl named Miiya. Set out on a spaceship and explore unique planets. Enjoy a thrilling adventure in the latest 3D anime art style.

releases.title: BPM: Bitcrushed
releases.summary: BPM Bitcrushed: A retro roguelite where every shot, dodge, and jump must sync to the beat. Battle through dungeons where enemies attack in time with the music. Find epic loot and even import your own songs to create a custom, rhythm-fuelled soundtrack for your destruction!

releases.title: Construction Simulator: Evolution
releases.summary: Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

releases.title: Cutout Village
releases.summary: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

releases.title: Nightmare Circus
releases.summary: Nightmare Circus is an action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of a Puppeteer trapped in the Nightmare Realm. Set out on a journey to find his friends and escape the nightmare!

releases.title: Dodo Duckie
releases.summary: Aliens abducted your chicken friends! Play as Dodo, a brave but slightly clueless duck on a mission to bring them home. The twist? Swap between 2D and 3D perspectives INSTANTLY to solve platforming puzzles and explore a cozy, charming world full of surprises

releases.title: Foxy Dumplings
releases.summary: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

releases.title: Cosmic Holidays
releases.summary: Help Cibo find his way in an unknown world. Through gorgeous flora and fauna, Cibo can glide in the wind, bounce, propel or block, absorb impacts or roll, using his power to inflate his head. Learn from hostile nature to make it your ally. Earn Cibo's trust until he reaches his vacation resort!

releases.title: Kosmocean: The Endless Sea
releases.summary: Adventure and submarine exploration game. Control your Bathyscaphe with the help of a logbook. Through the game puzzles, bullet-hell sequences, and skill-based challenges, you will be plunged miles and miles into the depths where the ocean seems to have no end.

releases.title: Dragon's Brew
releases.summary: Dragon's Brew is a board game cafe simulator! Serve customers while fulfilling takeaway orders and delivery requests and build up your reputation in the vibrant seaside town of Pebblebrook. Source and grow your own ingredients, craft a variety of seasonal recipes, and expand your board game collection. Discover and unlock 100+ board games, each with its own effects and bonuses. Pair them with specific menu items to trigger unique effects and create powerful synergies that enhance your cafe’s operations and profits.

releases.title: AlterMage
releases.summary: AlterMage is a first person metroidvania that combines spell-slinging action with a cerebral exploration experience. As an aspiring mage seeking to learn sorcery, you find yourself upon the shores of a forbidden island fortress. Take up your staff and set out on a journey that will challenge your mind, body, and spirit as you uncover the truth behind the citadel's origin.

releases.title: Bash Moto
releases.summary: Tear up the streets in this 90s themed beat'em up motorcycle racing game. Kick and bash your way through a slew of roughneck bikers all trying to claim victory and the cash prize. Take your hard earned cash and buy yourself a new bike to keep up with the pack or leave them in your dust.

releases.title: Hoa 2
releases.summary: Hoa 2 opens a long, long time after Hoa closed with its emotionally charged ending, leaving fans wondering what happened to the namesake little fairy. The cycle of life brings her back to a homeland reshaped by time, and her old friends have long since passed. Alone in a world both familiar and changed, Hoa must find new purpose in this gentle and heartfelt tale of change, of letting go and moving forward.

releases.title: Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story
releases.summary: "Sondro Gomez: A Sunova Story" is an action-adventure platformer following the story of a failing musician named Sondro, who must seek and recover the wish-granting Mystic Orbs to repay his debt to the mysterious Masked Man. Can he find them before the many rogues of Sunova beat him to the punch?

releases.title: Calame
releases.summary: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

releases.title: Call of Duty: Warzone
releases.summary: Call of Duty: Warzone is a free-to-play combat game with multiple modes and new gameplay updates. It includes Fortune’s Keep, Endgame (limited time), Battle Royale, Black Ops Royale, and Resurgence, each offering different match types and objectives.

releases.title: Infinite Alliance
releases.summary: Heroes and villains from 13+ Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

releases.title: Janet DeMornay is a Slumlord (and a witch)
releases.summary: Live the anxieties and horrors of what it is to be a renter in a world run by landlords. …and your landlord is a witch.

releases.title: Ungodly
releases.summary: UnGodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

releases.title: Bunny Rampage: History of Revenge
releases.summary:
Embark on a captivating adventure with Max, a plush rabbit brought to life!

Unfold the secrets hidden within captivating portals, venturing from the bustling streets of New York City to the enigmatic depths of an alien bunker. Face hordes of enemies in exhilarating battles, unravel mind-bending puzzles, and navigate challenging platforming sections.

releases.title: Meteora
releases.summary: Be a meteor in a constant race for survival in a young and chaotic universe by dodging, chasing & taking down other meteors in Meteora. Power up, strategize and put your skills to the test in our spectacular arcade combat racer!

releases.title: Couch Planes
releases.summary: Couch Planes is a fast-paced airborne party game where the craftiest pilot wins. Dodge missiles, grab power-ups, and race through hazard-filled maps in various game modes in chaotic local or online matches. Easy to learn, wild to master, always a blast.

releases.title: House Flipper 2: Pets
releases.summary: House Flipper 2 is getting rowdy! With dozens of pets to choose from, you can now adopt your new best friend. Let them accompany you during the pet-centered jobs or relax by petting them with your friends in the Co-op!

releases.title: NBA the Run
releases.summary: Take your favorite NBA stars to iconic streetball courts around the world, in this fast-paced, online 3v3 basketball game. Stack wins, earn cred and become the GOAT of THE RUN. Who's Got Next?

releases.title: The Tale of Mara & Moa
releases.summary: Mara and Moa have made a terrible mistake and now they need to find the Spirits of the Forest to save their village. Explore a world full of secrets with dynamic and fast-paced combat, alternating between the two characters and channeling the powers of the Sun and the Moon.

releases.title: R-Type Tactics I & II Cosmos: Limited Edition
releases.summary: Includes R-Type Tactics I・II Cosmos: Deluxe Edition, 2-Disc Soundtrack, Conceptual Art Card Set (Set of 6), R-9A Arrowhead Acrylic Stand, B-1D Bydo System Alpha Acrylic Stand, Collector's Box

releases.title: Tamer Town
releases.summary: Collect Mokitons in this city management game, where tamers and their monsters unite in battle, evolve and bond together in their unique town. Design neighborhoods, unlock stories and grow a feel-good world where every connection matters.

releases.title: Mannequin Mayhem: Physics Ragdoll Shooter
releases.summary: Get ready for a wild ride in "Mannequin Mayhem," the craziest shooter this year! Say goodbye to zombies and aliens; it's time to blast creepy mannequins. Survive endless waves, customize your arsenal, and embrace the chaos. Let's laugh and blast our way through the weirdest enemies ever!

releases.title: Relic Abyss
releases.summary: Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with might, magic, and lost technology! A mysterious tale centered around a world-devouring Abyss awaits...

releases.title: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
releases.summary: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

releases.title: Overserved: Food Fighters!
releases.summary: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

releases.title: Dice Gambit
releases.summary: A turn based tactics game where you roll and allocate dice to control your characters in combat. Completely customize your characters build with a huge array of powers that allow for boundless combinations. All set in a Neo-renaissance metropolis, filled with aristocratic families vying for power.

releases.title: Stunt Paradise 2
releases.summary: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

releases.title: Abiotic Factor: Entropic Break
releases.summary: Embark on a new tropical adventure, roaming sun-drenched seas and forgotten islands. Investigate the warped GATE Leaf Test Facility and surrounding isles, confronting a new breed of fanatics, digital disorder, far-flung anomalies, the Flesh Dimension, and more in this world-crossing DLC expansion.

releases.title: Captain Speedfin
releases.summary: Ahoy, matey! The clock is ticking for Captain Speedfin. Trapped with an hourglass that never stops, this pirate has only one choice: run. Your mission is simple but brutal: navigate 60 intense platforming levels to reclaim your chests before the last grain of sand falls. There are no special powers here—just pure skill. Every jump, slide, and dash is a test of your reflexes. In this world, the slightest mistake is fatal.

releases.title: Buckshot Roulette
releases.summary: Buckshot Roulette is an indie tabletop horror game that reimagines Russian roulette using a pump-action shotgun instead of a revolver. The player faces off against a computer-controlled opponent called "The Dealer" across three rounds, with consumable items introduced in later rounds that add strategic depth. The game features a single-player campaign and a multiplayer mode for up to four players.

releases.title: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror
releases.summary: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror is an upcoming third-person survival horror game set in a frozen gothic landscape. Players navigate cursed streets, morgues, and Dr. Frankenstein’s laboratory while surviving both brutal creatures and the horrors of his experiments.

releases.title: Curilemu
releases.summary: Curilemu is an adventure-horror game inspired by the myths and legends of Chilean Patagonia. Immerse yourself in a haunting world filled with Lovecraftian horrors and ancient mysteries. Fight colossal beasts and discover what is behind the plague to heal this island and restore the cosmic balance.

releases.title: Aegis Force: The Scorian War
releases.summary: Aegis Force is a single player, story-driven, strategy RPG (SRPG) that has an engaging grid-based tactical combat system. It is designed in a breathtaking 2.5d pixel art style. Players can recruit for and customize their party, using gameplay that includes full world and town exploration.

releases.title: Teios' Journey
releases.summary: Embark on a thrilling adventure through a vibrant world teeming with challenges and mysteries. Traverse diverse landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and engage in epic battles as you unravel the secrets hidden within the land.

releases.title: Bloodseed: The Last Helsing
releases.summary: Bloodseed is a game that combines two very distinct but terribly addictive genres; card combat and survival.

releases.title: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
releases.summary:
Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

releases.title: Delivery Issues
releases.summary: Delivery Issues is a side-scrolling package-throwing time-attack action-platformer that tests your package delivery skills against a zany world of characters and events that just happen to make an easy job... difficult.

releases.title: Endlight
releases.summary: Break through and outlast shifting, twisting, chaos. Fly through surreal landscapes desperately trying to get hoops. Dodging is impossible, so start smashing.

releases.title: Baradroid: A Gay Visual Novel
releases.summary: A choice-driven, high-tech, gay visual novel with elements of dating-sim! Choose your baradroid, Live with him, and... Can you teach a robot the meaning of human love?

releases.title: The Tag-along Obsession
releases.summary: The Tag-along Obsession is adapted from the movie "The Tag-along", based on the Urban Legend. It is a first-person horror puzzle adventure game, Players will play Hui-Ting and go into the situation to understand a series of supernatural phenomenon, and immerse themselves in the story, looking for the answers to everything.

releases.title: Doll Defenders
releases.summary: You were teleported to Male Doll's multiverse with one goal: to save the heroes of our games. However, you may fall in love with them along the way and get the happy final ending you deserve. Are you looking to save the world, or the love of one hot man that’s everything you ever wanted? Don't lie!

releases.title: Magnetic Bonds
releases.summary: Magnetic Bonds is a fusion of the visual novel and turn-based RPG genres inspired by shonen manga where players explore a vast galaxy, befriending characters and building relationships as they progress through the story and take down enemies and bosses.

releases.title: Depth Loop
releases.summary: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

releases.title: Never's End
releases.summary: Never's End is a turn-based tactical RPG where you return from death into the midst of a global cataclysm. Possess townsfolk to use them as living weapons, wield the forces of nature to reshape the battlefield, and lead mankind back from the brink of extinction.

releases.title: Metro Rivals: New York
releases.summary: Reputation is paramount; strategy is key, and all-out speed can make or break everything. Welcome to Metro Rivals—a genre-defying subway simcade game where you battle Track Titans in solo play or clash with friends in fierce PvP.

releases.title: Folklore Hunter
releases.summary: You are a hunter world reknowned for slaying supernatural beasts. Your next contract is to hunt down a wendigo plaguing a section of woods in north america. Gather resources, set traps, prepare your equipment, use your hunters instincts and take down the beast, before it hunts you.

releases.title: Slam City with Scottie Pippen: Respect Edition
Huni Kuin: Beya Xinã Bena
releases.summary: A 2D platform game about the ancient stories of the Huni Kuin indigenous people, who live in the Brazilian Amazon. The entire game was produced in collaboration with the Huni Kuin communities of the Jordão river, in Acre.

releases.title: Residiuum: Tales of Coral
releases.summary:
Explore a universe rich in personality and full of mysteries.

After the sun went mad and exploded, all that was left of the world was the Auric Earth. A region divided between the Elite with their suited men and their experiments and technologies with the multi-purpose gas Sig, and the less fortunate who must deal with gangs of criminals of various kinds and a hostile environment full of toxic and poisonous substances.

releases.title: Frog Legs
releases.summary: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?

releases.title: Zaleste
releases.summary: Shmup collaboration between Compile Heart and M2.

releases.title: R-Type Tactics I & II Cosmos: Deluxe Edition
releases.summary: Includes R-Type Tactics I・II Cosmos: Standard Edition, Digital Soundtrack and a Poster

releases.title: Ultima Chess VR
releases.summary: Ultima Chess VR – chess as you've never seen before! Battle on the chessboard in virtual reality, where every piece comes to life and engages in a fantasy duel!

releases.title: Dragon Realms
releases.summary: Be the dragon! Customise, upgrade, and dominate a vast fantasy world. Destroy castles, battle foes, gather treasure, and rule Dragon Realms!

releases.title: Cinema Manager Simulator
releases.summary: Manage and expand your own cinema. Upgrade equipment, customize interiors, schedule movies, set ticket prices, hire staff, and handle repairs to create the ultimate movie-watching experience!

releases.title: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
releases.summary: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

releases.title: Mechborn
releases.summary: Protect Earth and her colonies in a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by ’90s mech anime and Greek mythology. In MECHBORN - YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK - Unlock mech parts and pilots, craft custom decks and unleash devastating combos as you fight to repel the Kaiju incursions!

releases.title: Out of Sight: Stage Fright
releases.summary: Uncover the story of a tormented Unseen, a spirit child who reaches out to Sophie for help with their final performance. Together with Teddy, they reveal new perspectives, a chilling history, and a need to overcome their greatest fears.

releases.title: Escape Tsunami: Take Brainrots!
releases.summary: Dive into a chaotic arena where brainrots are scattered everywhere, just waiting to be taken and brought back to safety.

releases.title: Iron Saga VS
releases.summary: Take control of an assortment of superb mechs and engage in thrilling combat with other enthusiasts on the same battlefield! In addition to original mecha, well-known IPs such as "Mazinger Z" and “Dancouga – Super Beast Machine God” also ready for the mecha war!

releases.title: Castle of Alchemists
releases.summary: In Castle of Alchemists, a tower defense/top-down action hybrid game with amazing pixel art graphics, play as the Bellator, alchemically enhanced defender, to fight against invaders from other worlds. Delve into the castle, set your traps, equip powerful weapons and gears, and reclaim the castle piece by piece.

releases.title: FIFA Heroes
releases.summary: FIFA Heroes game will bring together FIFA's official mascots and recognizable fictional characters alongside football's biggest icons. This is arcade football reimagined with matches that are quick, explosive and full of surprises. Players will be able to master superpowers such as teleport dribble, flaming power shot, or magnetic tackle to turn matches upside down. Build your squad, master their skills, and dominate the competition in a brand-new way to play the world's favourite sport. Solace partnered with leading NYC game studio Enver to publish and develop FIFA Heroes. Founded in 2021 and based in New York City, Enver is a media-first gaming company creating culture-shaping worlds.

releases.title: LightSup!
releases.summary: LightSup! is a couch-action co-op game for 1-4 players with rogue-lite elements where you play as adventurers encounter ferocious monsters crawling from the Eclipse Dungeons. Prepare your weapons and protect the Altar of Light at any cost, or the world will be doomed into darkness forever.

releases.title: The Ashen Oz
releases.summary: A fast-paced dark fantasy action roguelite where you chain attacks and parries into fluid, combo-driven combat through a twisted fairytale world.

releases.title: Dominus Gladiatus
releases.summary: Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly tournament against rival Domini.

releases.title: Farmageddon
releases.summary: In this Action Roguelike, defend your farm from waves of enemies attacking with live vegetables. Dodge, catch, and use their own projectiles against them to survive. Uncover the conspiracy driving their revenge—a secret they don't even know themselves.

releases.title: House Flipper Remastered Collection
releases.summary: House Flipper Remastered Collection lets you become a one-person renovation crew. Clean, build, decorate, and sell for profit! Now with better graphics, voice acting, all expansions in one toolbox, and some more heartfelt addition. It’s flipping time!

releases.title: Garage Mechanic Simulator 2026
releases.summary: Build your own car empire in Garage Mechanics 2026

releases.title: The Obsessive Shadow: Chapter 2
releases.summary: Something sinister stirs on Old Diamond Drive. 16 year old Justin, armed only with a flashlight and camcorder, takes a dare to spend the night. As shadows close in, he realizes escape isn't possible, and he's not alone. Witness the horrors of the past as you explore the ruins of what once thrived...

releases.title: Cookie Cutter: Overkill Edition
releases.summary:
Cookie Cutter is a gorgeous hand-drawn techno-pop-punk post-kawaii Metroidvania. Play as the heroine Cherry on a quest for revenge as you run, jump, explore, and fight your way through a beautifully blood-soaked world.

Overkill Edition features All new voice work! Brand new attacks and cut scenes, updated map features and tons of gameplay tweaks!

releases.title: Road Truckers: New Beginning
releases.summary:
Live a trucker’s life in the first trucking sim RPG. Explore villages, cities and wilderness in a fully customizable truck. Get on-foot to eat, sleep, and help people along the way. Your goal: to bring back prosperity in your region. Drive, grow, and inspire!

Experience trucking on a new level: by driving and interacting with the world around you. Make your truck unique by customizing it mechanically and visually, inside and outside. Meet people and decide how to approach them. Enjoy the beautiful scenery in different weather conditions. But most of all, see the change you’re making by supporting the economy.

releases.title: Forza Horizon 6: Welcome Pack
releases.summary: Discover Japan with everything you need to get started and accelerate your racing journey to Horizon Legend with the Forza Horizon 6 Welcome Pack.

releases.title: Forza Horizon 6: VIP Membership
releases.summary: Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership is your permanent ticket to even more rewards at the Horizon Festival. Enjoy a 2x Credit boost to race rewards, 3 VIP-Exclusive Forza Edition cars, a weekly bonus Super Wheelspin, and special Vanity Items including the Crown Flair, Emote and Car Horn. You’ll also be handed the keys to the lavish Tokyo City House, a classic Japanese home in the suburbs that includes a Customizable Garage with a space to show off your favorite cars. Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership can be purchased separately and is included with Premium Edition and Premium Upgrade. This lifetime membership is a single purchase and will always be yours to enjoy in Forza Horizon 6. Join the Horizon VIP Club today!

releases.title: Forza Horizon 6: Treasure Map
releases.summary:
Need some help finding all of the Bonus Boards, Barn Finds, Regional Mascots, Treasure Chests and Treasure Cars hidden around Japan?

Get the Forza Horizon 6 Treasure Map today to reveal the exact location of these collectables in the main game and Expansions, once they become available.

releases.title: Oh Demon! Fix my TV
releases.summary: In this horror, comedy, and puzzle game, you will play as a demon summoned by an old woman to fix her television, sending you on an adventure beyond all reason.

releases.title: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
releases.summary: Be a stone Golem and try to save Nature with the help of an adorable Fox! Reconnect ancient sources of energy in environmental puzzles. Discover secrets from a lost civilization and save animals on an emotional quest in a cozy, colorful world.

releases.title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: DLC 4
Egypt Frontiers
releases.summary: In the game Egypt Frontiers, players explore ancient Egypt, constructing authentic pyramid and making strategic decisions. The game offers the opportunity to learn about real history or create their own vision of civilization in both strategy and first-person modes.

releases.title: Monowave
releases.summary: MONOWAVE is a puzzle-adventure platformer built around four emotions: happiness, sorrow, anger, and anxiety. Players use each emotion's abilities and pass emotions to other spirits through song to solve puzzles and explore the world. The game supports solo play and two-player local co-op, with one player controlling Mono and the other controlling Prism.

releases.title: What Goes Up
releases.summary: A chaotic co-op physics-building game where you stack, balance and jury rig gigantic junk towers to ridiculous heights for collection using the power of grav guns and friendship before the clock runs out

releases.title: Blue Bite
releases.summary: Your "fingertips" will save the world! "BLUE BITE" is a fully voiced 3D romance action adventure set in a world inhabited only by women. Six heroines are threatened by the mysterious disease "bluebite", and the only cure is... your "massage"! Explore the 3D world and save the girls!

releases.title: Hozy Hideaways
releases.summary: A free DLC for all Hozy players, invites you to explore three new levels - each with its own unique atmosphere and personality. Meet the characters who call these spaces home, discover the little details that make each place unique, and take your time turning them into something special.

releases.title: 80's Disco Brawl
releases.summary: 80's Disco Brawl is a rhythm-based beat ’em up that throws you into the spotlight of the wildest dance floor in history, where every fight is a rhythm, every hit a beat, and every move a performance. Step into a world where combat and music collide, and your timing becomes your greatest weapon.
